chapter: Europe 1933, New York Cotton Club, Hodges group
title: Leaving with Hodges and the small group
summary: He, Hodges and Al Sears formed a group with Shorty Baker and Emmett Berry that lasted about four years and had hit Castle Rock.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money
story.community_name: Playing in Lionel Hampton's big band

blocks.x: When you left, with Johnny and -- you and Johnny and who else left at the same time?
Johnny and I left the band and we were joined by Al Sears in New York. And we had the nucleus of a very nice little group.
But you get those pressures from high up when you go to the job -- well, I'm sorry I can't take you. And --
Was that why Johnny's group didn't make it (inaudible)?
Well, I won't say one thing or another, but if you knew everything you could judge for yourself.
So it was booking pressure --
Booking pressures and blocksand things like that.
But you had the quintet, right?
There was eight of us.
There were eight?
Yes. Four horns -- no, seven of us at first. Seven of us.
Who were the seven?
Four horns and three rhythm. Drums, bass,
and piano. And there was -- well it wound up with Shorty Baker, and myself on the brass, and Al Sears and Johnny on the sax.
And the piano player's name was Berry, right?
I forget what the piano player's name was. We had two or three of them. They changed two or three times.
Who was -- were bass and drums?
Oh, --
I saw the (inaudible) but I can't remember.
I can't even remember now too cause -- we got -- one time we had John Coltrane trained with us.
For how long?

Very short time. And so Johnny -- that didn't fit with us at all, so I think -- oh, I -- we had -- I can't remember the names of the fellows we had. They changed -- you know -- they changed every so often.
Well did Shorty Baker play very long with the group? I don't remember --
Berry played quite awhile. Emmett Berry. Emmett Berry was with us quite awhile. Yes, Shorty was in the last group. He was terrific. Very, very good.
And you had (inaudible) the one hit records
"Castle Rock" -- that was a Sears number.
Al Sears's number.
But it was Johnny's group that made the --
Well you know -- everybody helps --
Wasn't it good for the group then to have --
Yes, fine. That carried the booking several times.
Altogether -- the group was together how long -- four years?
About four years. About four years.
